content:
Hey all!
I feel fairly confident to announce the release of SDL3 bindings to Lean 4
https://github.com/ValorZard/lean-sdl3

Simple DirectMedia Layer (SDL for short) is a cross-platform library designed to make it easy to write multi-media software, such as games and emulators. It has a lot of good stuff in it, and it's fairly common to see game studios use it as the basis for their own custom game engines since it gives you everything you need.

If you'd like to see the bindings in action, here's a test project you can take a look at: https://github.com/ValorZard/lean-sdl-test

This took a lot of work and effort on my end, but I have to give a special shoutout to @Oliver Dressler since a lot of the original code is based on the work he did on LeanDoomed (https://github.com/oOo0oOo/LeanDoomed)
I have a sample project linked in the README where you can play around with the bindings, and I hope to replace the current way LeanDoomed handles SDL with my new bindings library in a future PR.

I'd love for all of you to play around with the bindings, and yell at me for what I should fix. (PRs are also especially welcome)

The Ludum Dare Game Jam is coming up in a few weeks, so I'd love if people would be interested in using this library to maybe submit a game for it :eyes:

(Or, if you want to get in the Halloween spirit, you could try https://itch.io/jam/scream-jam-2025 )

Next steps for me are:

  • Remake Flappy Bird using these bindings
  • Write a tutorial on how to make Flappy Bird once I've figured it out
  • Improve the bindings and add more stuff (want to add SDL_ttf and SDL_mixer at some point)
Discussion thread here: #general > Making SDL3 bindings for Lean 4
